hunks.baseline: This was the report Im Chunsoo received three days after ordering the investigation. After reading through the densely packed information filling five pages, he opened his mouth.
hunks.sol: Im Chunsoo received the report three days after ordering the investigation. After reading through five densely packed pages, he spoke.

hunks.baseline: The Team 1 Leader seated across from him answered. Apart from Guild Master Im Chunsoo, he was the only A-rank Hunter in Sangdong Guild, as well as Im Chunsoo’s loyal right hand.
hunks.sol: The Team 1 Leader sat across from him. Aside from Guild Master Im Chunsoo himself, he was Sangdong Guild’s only A-rank Hunter and Chunsoo’s loyal right-hand man.

hunks.baseline: “Did you read this report?”
hunks.sol: “Have you read this report?”

hunks.baseline: “Because it was your order, Guild Master. You told us to report any information that came in without filtering it along the way.”
hunks.sol: “Because of your instructions, Guild Master. You told me to pass along any new information exactly as it came in, without filtering it first.”

hunks.baseline: The Team 1 Leader politely accepted the report Im Chunsoo held out to him. His eyes moved rapidly across the pages. About ten minutes later, he raised his head and muttered,
hunks.sol: The Team 1 Leader respectfully accepted the report Im Chunsoo held out. His eyes raced across the pages. About ten minutes later, he looked up and muttered,

hunks.baseline: “I can only follow your judgment, Guild Master.”
hunks.sol: “I’ll defer to your judgment, Guild Master.”

hunks.baseline: “I think the information is incorrect.”
hunks.sol: “I believe the information is incorrect.”

hunks.baseline: “The subject of the report, Jin Taekyung, was an F-rank Hunter until only half a month ago. However, he succeeded in reawakening as a C-rank Hunter. That much is rare, but not impossible.”
hunks.sol: “The subject of the report, Jin Taekyung, was an F-rank Hunter until just two weeks ago. Then he successfully reawakened as a C-rank Hunter. That much is rare, but not impossible.”

hunks.baseline: “But according to the testimony of Team Leader Im Changsoo—no, Hunter Im Changsoo—and the others who participated in that raid, Jin Taekyung single-handedly defeated a group of B-rank monsters, the Minotaurs.”
hunks.sol: “But according to the testimony of Team Leader Im Changsoo—no, Hunter Im Changsoo—and the others who participated in the raid, Jin Taekyung single-handedly defeated a group of B-rank Minotaurs.”

terminology_alerts.message: preferred glossary term appears in BASE but not SOL for this hunk

hunks.baseline: “Minimum five. Maximum ten, if I remember correctly?”
hunks.sol: “At least five. As many as ten, if I remember correctly?”

hunks.baseline: “Right. A mere C-rank Hunter taking down a Minotaur Warrior with one blow. Does that make any sense?”
hunks.sol: “Right. Some measly C-rank Hunter took down a Minotaur Warrior in one blow. Does that make any sense?”

hunks.baseline: “I don’t think it does.”
hunks.sol: “I don’t believe it does.”

hunks.baseline: He was not asking because he genuinely did not know. He only wanted to confirm once again whether the Team 1 Leader was thinking the same thing he was.
hunks.sol: He was not asking because he did not know. He merely wanted to confirm that the Team 1 Leader had reached the same conclusion.

hunks.baseline: “There are three things that concern me.”
hunks.sol: “There are three suspicious possibilities.”

hunks.baseline: “List them.”
hunks.sol: “Let’s hear them.”

hunks.baseline: “First, the report may be wrong.”
hunks.sol: “First, the report could be wrong.”

hunks.baseline: “Who wrote this report? Hong… What was it? Definitely not Hong Gil-dong.”
hunks.sol: “Who wrote this report again? Hong… What was it? Definitely not Hong Gil-dong.”

hunks.baseline: “Hong Woojin. He’s still young and doesn’t have much experience, but his ability is well known.”
hunks.sol: “Hong Woojin. He’s still young and relatively inexperienced, but his skills are well regarded.”

hunks.baseline: “Right, that Hong Woojin—or Hong Gil-dong, or whatever the hell his name is. Check with that bastard again. Put some pressure on him, too. Anyway, what’s the second?”
hunks.sol: “Right. Hong Woojin, Hong Gil-dong, whatever the bastard’s name is. Check with him again. Put some pressure on him, too. Anyway, what’s the second?”

hunks.baseline: “Changsoo’s an idiot who can’t think straight, but he’s never lied to me in his life. Continue.”
hunks.sol: “Changsoo may be an idiot with his head screwed on wrong, but he’s never lied to me in his life. Continue.”

hunks.baseline: “The last possibility is that Jin Taekyung is an A-rank Hunter whose strength has not yet been confirmed, or perhaps…”
hunks.sol: “The final possibility is that Jin Taekyung is an A-rank Hunter whose abilities haven’t been confirmed yet, or perhaps…”

hunks.baseline: A troubled look crossed the otherwise calm Team 1 Leader’s face. After a moment, he hesitantly opened his mouth.
hunks.sol: A troubled look crossed the otherwise composed Team 1 Leader’s face. After a moment, he spoke hesitantly.

hunks.baseline: “Could he be a third-awakening Hunter?”
hunks.sol: “Could he have awakened a third time?”

hunks.baseline: “Third awakening?”
hunks.sol: “A third time?”

hunks.baseline: “Team 1 Leader. Doesn’t it sound absurd even to you? A third-awakening Hunter? Does that make any sense?”
hunks.sol: “Team 1 Leader. It sounds absurd even to you, doesn’t it? A third awakening? Does that make any sense?”

hunks.baseline: The Team 1 Leader answered by lowering his head.
hunks.sol: The Team 1 Leader lowered his head in lieu of an answer.

hunks.baseline: Im Chunsoo clicked his tongue at the sight and picked up the report. Extreme cold began to flow from his fingertips.
hunks.sol: Im Chunsoo clicked his tongue and picked up the report. Bitter cold flowed from his fingertips.

hunks.baseline: “Rewrite the report. Finish it by the end of this week and put it on my desk when you come in on Monday. Make it nice and clean.”
hunks.sol: “Rewrite the report. Finish it by the end of the week and have it on my desk when I come in Monday. Nice and clean.”

hunks.baseline: “And what about the information on the other people from that Peace Guild—or was it Love Guild?”
hunks.sol: “And what about the others from that Peace Guild—or was it Love Guild?”

hunks.baseline: “……I was just about to report on that.”
hunks.sol: “…I was just about to report on that.”

hunks.baseline: “We’ve finished identifying everyone except for three people.”
hunks.sol: “We’ve finished investigating everyone except three people.”

hunks.baseline: “Three? One of them must be Jin Taekyung. Who are the other two?”
hunks.sol: “Three? One must be Jin Taekyung. Who are the other two?”

hunks.baseline: “The Guild Master and Team Leader of Peace Guild.”
hunks.sol: “Peace Guild’s Guild Master and Team Leader.”

hunks.baseline: He had heard about them from his son. The young Team Leader was an insolent brat, while the middle-aged Guild Master was a clueless man who had done nothing but chuckle throughout the entire raid.
hunks.sol: His son had mentioned them before. The young Team Leader was an insolent brat, while the middle-aged Guild Master was a clueless man who had done nothing but chuckle throughout the entire raid.

hunks.baseline: “Why those two?”
hunks.sol: “What about them?”

hunks.baseline: “There was a Lock on them.”
hunks.sol: “Their records were locked.”

hunks.baseline: “Exactly as I said. Not only their personal information, but even their account details are all under security restrictions. The Audit Team is at a loss as well.”
hunks.sol: “Just as I said. Their personal information and even their bank account details are all secured. The Audit Team doesn’t know what to make of it either.”
Running a Guild required help from government agencies. The corrupt officials who worked for them had no qualms about accepting bribes in exchange for information.

hunks.baseline: “Not at all. I already gave them plenty…”
hunks.sol: “I already gave them plenty…”

hunks.baseline: “And yet?”
hunks.sol: “And?”

hunks.baseline: “They seem very reluctant on their end as well. They said an upper agency had placed the security lock, making it difficult for them to touch.”
hunks.sol: “Even they’re clearly reluctant to touch this. They said a higher agency imposed the security restrictions, so it would be difficult to interfere.”

hunks.baseline: A Guild that had not even existed for a month. A small Guild whose entire membership could not even make up one raid team. No, at that point, calling it a Guild was strange. It would not have been odd to call it a social club instead.
hunks.sol: The Guild had existed for less than a month. Its entire membership was too small to fill a single raid team. At that size, it would hardly be strange to call it a social club instead of a Guild.

hunks.baseline: And yet, who the hell were those bastards to have a Lock placed on them?
hunks.sol: So who the hell were those bastards to have their records locked?

hunks.baseline: “Huh. Look at these bastards.”
hunks.sol: “Well, look at these bastards.”

hunks.baseline: “Don’t dig any deeper into that part for now. Leave it alone. And make absolutely sure the people we paid this time keep their mouths shut.”
hunks.sol: “Don’t dig any deeper into that for now. Leave it alone. And make damn sure everyone we paid keeps their mouth shut.”

hunks.baseline: During the Great Cataclysm, Im Chunsoo had been famous for his fiery temper. But after running a Guild, he had learned one important thing.
hunks.sol: During the Great Cataclysm, Im Chunsoo had been famous for his fiery temper. But running a Guild had taught him one important lesson.

hunks.baseline: To achieve a goal—and to gain results beyond that goal—one had to remain calm and cautious.
hunks.sol: To achieve his goals—and gain even more than he had set out to—he had to remain calm and cautious.

hunks.baseline: “So everything else is completely investigated?”
hunks.sol: “So aside from those three, you’ve investigated everyone?”

hunks.baseline: That was the answer of the Team 1 Leader, who had earned Im Chunsoo’s trust through his meticulous nature. Im Chunsoo nodded.
hunks.sol: The Team 1 Leader’s meticulous nature had earned Im Chunsoo’s trust. Chunsoo nodded.

hunks.baseline: “Deal with those two locked targets as I said. For now, focus only on Jin Taekyung. Mobilize a few people from the Guild Audit Team and increase the surveillance separately.”
hunks.sol: “Handle those two with locked records the way I just told you. For now, focus on Jin Taekyung. Pull in a few people from the Guild Audit Team and put more eyes on him.”

hunks.baseline: “Separately…?”
hunks.sol: “More…?”

hunks.baseline: “Yes. Looking at the state of this report, it’s no good. When you think about it, our Guild Audit Team isn’t exactly outclassed, is it?”
hunks.sol: “Yeah. This report is no good. And when you think about it, our Guild Audit Team is no slouch either, is it?”

hunks.baseline: The Team 1 Leader suddenly hesitated. He remembered what Hong Woojin had repeatedly stressed when he went to commission Woojin for the job.
hunks.sol: The Team 1 Leader faltered. He remembered what Hong Woojin had repeatedly stressed when he commissioned the investigation.

hunks.baseline: > “The moment I accept this assignment, it becomes my job. Got it? Within a week, I’ll find out the color of this bastard’s underwear on the day in question, so leave it to me. If you cause trouble on your end and the surveillance target catches on, you’ll ruin my job.”
hunks.sol: > “The moment I accept this assignment, it becomes my job. Got it? Within a week, I’ll find out what color underwear the bastard wore that day, so leave it to me. If you start something on your end and tip off the surveillance target, you’ll ruin my work.”

hunks.baseline: Hong Woojin had little experience, but word had spread that he was good at his work. Despite Woojin’s arrogant way of speaking, his professionalism had inspired trust, and the Team 1 Leader had personally given him his word.
hunks.sol: Hong Woojin had little experience, but word had spread that he was good at his job. His arrogant tone aside, his professionalism had inspired confidence, and the Team 1 Leader had personally given him his word.

hunks.baseline: *I should probably tell him.*
hunks.sol: *I should tell him.*

hunks.baseline: But the objection the Team 1 Leader was about to raise went straight back down his throat at Im Chunsoo’s next words.
hunks.sol: But the objection he was about to raise slipped straight back down his throat at Im Chunsoo’s next words.

hunks.baseline: “Why? Is there something else you want to say?”
hunks.sol: “Why? Something else you want to say?”

hunks.baseline: “Oh, no, sir. I’ll relay it exactly as you said.”
hunks.sol: “Oh, no, sir. I’ll pass along your orders.”

hunks.baseline: Im Chunsoo had been in a bad mood lately. It was the Team 1 Leader’s job to keep him appeased as much as possible and guide him in a favorable direction.
hunks.sol: Im Chunsoo had been in a foul mood lately. The Team 1 Leader’s job was to appease him as much as possible while steering him in the right direction.

hunks.baseline: *It’ll be fine, right? It will be.*
hunks.sol: *It’ll be fine, right? It’ll be fine.*

hunks.baseline: Even after leaving the Guild Master’s office, the Team 1 Leader could not shake his uneasy feeling.
hunks.sol: Even after leaving the Guild Master’s office, the Team 1 Leader could not shake his unease.

hunks.baseline: Just thinking about those two words made me happy. And in reality, it was just as wonderful. But…
hunks.sol: Just thinking about those two words made me happy. The reality was every bit as wonderful.
Except…

hunks.baseline: I swatted at a fly with lightning-fast speed. It was not an ordinary palm strike, either—my palm was charged with internal energy. After killing the fly instantly, I tossed it into the trash and returned to the sofa.
hunks.sol: I swatted a fly with lightning speed. Not with an ordinary palm, either, but one charged with internal energy. I tossed the fly, dead in one strike, into the trash and returned to the sofa.

hunks.baseline: “Why the hell are there so many flies?”
hunks.sol: “Why the hell are there so many fucking flies?”

hunks.baseline: Hayeon, who had briefly come out into the living room to get a drink of water, let out a deep sigh.
hunks.sol: Hayeon had stepped into the living room for a drink of water. She let out a deep sigh.

hunks.baseline: “It’s not just that.”
hunks.sol: “I’m telling you, this is more than that.”

hunks.baseline: “What’s the big deal? How many could there be? There was only one just now.”
hunks.sol: “How many could there possibly be? There was only one just now.”

hunks.baseline: “That’s the problem. They keep coming in one at a time. Every time I catch one, another one keeps coming in from somewhere.”
hunks.sol: “That’s the problem. They keep coming in one at a time. Every time I kill one, another shows up from somewhere.”

hunks.baseline: “How many have you caught?”
hunks.sol: “How many have you killed?”

hunks.baseline: “I swear to heaven, I’ve caught at least a hundred since this morning.”
hunks.sol: “I swear to heaven, I’ve killed a hundred since this morning.”

hunks.baseline: “Look at you exaggerating. This is why men are…”
hunks.sol: “Listen to you exaggerate. Men…”

hunks.baseline: Damn, this was driving me crazy. I tore at my hair and swatted down another fly. A hundred? I was not exaggerating at all. What had happened to this neighborhood that so many flies could swarm into one house?
hunks.sol: Wow. This was driving me insane. I tore at my hair and swatted another fly. A hundred? That was no exaggeration. What the hell was wrong with this neighborhood that one house could be overrun with so many flies?

hunks.baseline: At first, they had only been annoying. Just like Hayeon had said, I thought it was a normal phenomenon because it was summer.
hunks.sol: At first, they had merely been annoying. Like Hayeon said, I assumed they were only around because it was summer.

hunks.baseline: But the more time passed, the more I realized that something was strange.
hunks.sol: But as time passed, I realized something was off.

hunks.baseline: *It was after I’d killed about thirty of them.*
hunks.sol: *It was after I’d killed about thirty.*

hunks.baseline: These damn things kept coming in without a break! I would kill one, then another would come in. I would kill that one, and a different fly would take its place.
hunks.sol: The damn things kept coming in without a break! I killed one, and another appeared. I killed that one, and a different one came in to take its place.

hunks.baseline: Even after closing every window in the house and searching with my Qi Sense, the nightmare of the fly army continued.
hunks.sol: Even after I closed every window and searched the whole house with Qi Sense, the nightmare of the fly army continued.

hunks.baseline: “See? Another one came in before we could even turn around. Where the hell are these things coming from?”
hunks.sol: “See? Another one showed up already. Where the hell do these things keep coming from?”

hunks.baseline: I carefully searched for some tiny gap I had failed to notice, but I could not figure it out. They seemed to be coming through spaces barely large enough for a single ant to pass through.
hunks.sol: I searched carefully for some tiny gap I might have missed, but I could not find one. They seemed to be squeezing through spaces barely large enough for an ant.

hunks.baseline: “Don’t swat them. Just leave them alone. Then they’ll quiet down.”
hunks.sol: “Stop swatting them and leave them alone. Then they’ll quiet down.”

hunks.baseline: “What kind of creative bullshit is that? You think they’ll stay still just because you leave them alone? We won’t be able to sleep with all that buzzing.”
hunks.sol: “What kind of creative bullshit is that? You think they’ll sit still just because you leave them alone? We obviously won’t be able to sleep with them buzzing all night.”

hunks.baseline: “There are about three in my room, too. They bothered me at first, so I thought about killing them, but when I left them alone, they stopped flying around and just sat on my desk.”
hunks.sol: “There are about three in there. They bothered me at first, so I thought about killing them, but when I left them alone, they stopped flying around and just sat on my desk.”

hunks.baseline: “That’s only temporary. They must fly around like crazy when you’re not looking.”
hunks.sol: “That’s only temporary. They probably fly around like crazy when you’re not looking.”

hunks.baseline: “I think they’re just lazy flies. They haven’t moved even once.”
hunks.sol: “I think they’re just lazy flies. They haven’t moved once.”

hunks.baseline: “You even have a hundred thousand won? You’re an examinee.”
hunks.sol: “You even have a hundred thousand won? You’re a high school senior.”

hunks.baseline: “Of course I do. It’s from the money you gave me last time.”
hunks.sol: “Of course I do. It’s the money you gave me last time.”

hunks.baseline: “If you’re scared, you can just die.”
hunks.sol: “If you’re scared, you can fuck off and die.”

hunks.baseline: “……Deal.”
hunks.sol: “…Deal.”

hunks.baseline: We went straight to Hayeon’s room. She pointed at a fly sitting quietly in place and grinned triumphantly.
hunks.sol: We went straight to Hayeon’s room. She pointed at a fly sitting quietly on her desk and grinned triumphantly.

hunks.baseline: “See? I was right, wasn’t I? Hand over the hundred thousand won.”
hunks.sol: “See? I was right. Hurry up and hand over the hundred thousand won.”

hunks.baseline: I brought my palm down over the fly. I struck at an ordinary person’s speed, slow enough for the fly to dodge easily. But then…
hunks.sol: I brought my palm down toward the fly. I moved at an ordinary person’s speed, slow enough for it to dodge easily.
But then…

hunks.baseline: The fly startled violently and scurried away, moving its legs as fast as it could.
hunks.sol: The fly jumped in alarm and scurried away as fast as its legs could carry it.

hunks.baseline: I could not hide my bewilderment. Hayeon wore a similar expression.
hunks.sol: I stared in disbelief. Hayeon looked just as baffled.

hunks.baseline: “Are all flies these days like that?”
hunks.sol: “Do flies act like that these days?”

hunks.baseline: “Th-They could be, couldn’t they? Anyway, give me the hundred thousand won.”
hunks.sol: “M-Maybe they do? Anyway, give me the hundred thousand won.”

hunks.baseline: “I’ll give it to you. I will. But isn’t that fly strange?”
hunks.sol: “I will. I’ll give it to you, but… isn’t that fly weird?”

hunks.baseline: “A fly is a fly. It’s just a weird one.”
hunks.sol: “A fly is a fly. That one’s just a little strange.”

hunks.baseline: “What kind of fly acts like that? I’ve seen goblins and Minotaurs in my life, but I’ve never seen a fly that flies around so little.”
hunks.sol: “What kind of fly acts like that? I’ve seen goblins and Minotaurs, but I’ve never seen a fly so determined not to fly.”

hunks.baseline: The instant I finished speaking—
hunks.sol: The moment I finished speaking—

hunks.baseline: Suspicious. Extremely suspicious.
hunks.sol: Suspicious. Way too suspicious.

hunks.baseline: The timing was questionable enough, but the way its wings moved—as if it were trying hard to look ordinary—was even stranger. Even its flight was awkward and unsteady.
hunks.sol: The timing was bad enough, but the way it beat its wings—as if it were trying to look normal—was even stranger. Its flight was awkward and wobbly, too.

hunks.baseline: *Forget that. It gives me the creeps. This feeling is weirdly familiar.*
hunks.sol: *Never mind that. It gives me the creeps. This feeling is weirdly familiar.*

hunks.baseline: Where had I felt something similar?
hunks.sol: Where had I felt something like this before?

hunks.baseline: Oh, right. That alley I had walked through on the way home two days ago, after looking at a house.
hunks.sol: Oh, right. That alley I had walked through two days ago, on my way home from viewing the house.

hunks.baseline: That déjà vu of someone secretly watching me.
hunks.sol: That strange sense of déjà vu, as though someone were watching me.

hunks.baseline: I glared at the fly and raised my Qi Sense. Its activation range now extended to a radius of seventy meters, spreading into every corner of the house.
hunks.sol: I glared at the fly and activated Qi Sense. Its range now extended seventy meters in every direction, reaching into every corner of the house.

hunks.baseline: And then something no one could have expected happened.
hunks.sol: Then something no one could have expected happened.
